HOW TO PREP FOR BLACK FRIDAY SALES AND SHOP SMARTER

HOW TO PREP FOR BLACK FRIDAY SALES AND SHOP SMARTER

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 5:11
Instaread

BLACK FRIDAY is almost here, but guess what? The sales have ALREADY STARTED! And if you’re anything like me, you know how easy it is to get distracted by a really good deal. Before you know it, you’ve bought things you never planned on buying! So this year, let’s go into the holiday shopping season with a PLAN. A little preparation can save you time, money, and a whole lot of stress!

✨ HOW TO SHOP THIS POST ✨
I’ve switched to SHOPMY carousels, so shopping looks a little different! SWIPE LEFT to see more items, HOVER over a product to see it, and CLICK to shop. On your phone, just SWIPE and TAP! You can also click any STORE NAME to shop that store’s whole sale.

SHOP MY LOOK ABOVE

MAKE YOUR LIST

Before you start shopping take the time to sit down and make your Christmas gift list. Think about who you’re buying for, what they might love, and how much you want to spend. Don’t forget about those little extras like stocking stuffers, hostess gifts, and maybe something for YOU……… REMEMBER to always advocate for yourself!!!!

Having a list makes shopping SO much easier, especially when the sales start coming fast!!!

KNOW WHAT YOU’RE LOOKING FOR

If you’ve had your eye on something specific, NOW is the time to start watching prices. Whether it’s clothing, beauty products, gadgets, or even home decor….. knowing what you want ahead of time makes it easier to recognize a GREAT DEAL!

And remember, just because something is on sale doesn’t mean you need it! HAVE A PURPOSE!

STICK TO YOUR LIST AND YOUR BUDGET

This might be the hardest part! BUDGETS are the best way to keep you on track! Feeling like you’ve been successful in this area feels so rewarding!
